results.detail: Most steps are exact: the SQL, the expected = course amount x count calculation, the split conditions, NULL -> FailComponent, Aggregate grouping on care/delivery date/appendix date with min value date, ToLocalTime on the written dates, DateDiff on raw values (marked as general .NET knowledge), the 1000 batch and remainder flush, Fault -> ETL warning without the id, and gen_customercareid used instead of Entity.Id. Two problems remain. (a) Step 1 says 'תנועות השנה השוטפת' (current-year transactions) as fact. That comes only from the name of the unsupplied view Gen_ftCurrentYear. Rule 4 makes the view external_unknown, so its content must be labelled as a hypothesis based on the name. (b) Step 29 is incomplete. When ExcecuteBulk fails inside a row (for example no server response), the exception is caught and that row is routed to CastingError. But myEntities.Clear() is skipped, and the failing row's entity has already been added to the list. The failed batch, including the row reported as an error, stays queued. Count == 1000 can never hold again, so every later care is accumulated and sent in one ExecuteMultiple at end of rowset. That final call is outside any try, so a failure there fails the component. The ETL warning for the row therefore does not mean that the care was not closed.

results.detail: Source and population (Gen_ftCurrentYear named neutrally), matching (gen_customercareid attribute, no Entity.Id), decisions 1-5, the write (constants 3/34 named as the code constants, conditional date attributes, batch of 1000, Supported through an external Proxy that was not inspected) and the hedged result all match the DTSX.

All six decisions are exact: the WHERE clause (DTSX:2135-2137), 'Gen_isfulltransfer ==  TRUE' with FailComponent on the IsFull output (DTSX:2091), transferCount > 0 with 'Has not thansactions' not connected, the Compare sums expression with 'Sums Are Not Equal' not connected, Aggregate GroupBy x3 with AggregationType 6 on gen_valuedate, and DateDiff(DateInterval.Day, deliveryDate, valuedate) > 0, sent only if both dates are non-null (DateDiff semantics marked as general knowledge).

All five open questions are real gaps that the files cannot answer. There is no care-type filter; the OptionSet meanings exist only as constant names; sum(ac.gen_transactionamount) is multiplied by the group row count; per-group partial closure happens through the Union All; a NULL Gen_isfulltransfer fails the component (FailComponent).
